name: Dana Whitfield
message: We manage 420 doors across three markets and our books are a mess. Month-end close takes our bookkeeper nine days and we are still chasing late rent from August. Lost our bookkeeper in September and have not replaced her.
reason: 420 doors, books a mess: nine-day month-end close, August arrears, bookkeeper left in September and not replaced.

Would you have 20 minutes this week for a short call so we can look at how your books are set up today?
